free_text: The decision to recommend a biopsy is supported by high-risk features, including a PI-RADS 5 lesion and a prior positive biopsy result. Although the patient has moderate LUTS (IPSS 9/35), the combination of rising PSA (4.2 ng/mL) and the prior positive finding necessitates further tissue diagnosis. Therefore, a prostate biopsy is recommended to evaluate the extent of the disease.
